SHOP-NS-001.title: Shopify integration - NetSuite
SHOP-NS-001.summary: Connect your Shopify store, your Melonn logistics operator, and your NetSuite ERP in a seamless integration. Automate the synchronization of customers, orders, invoices, payments, credit notes, and inventory. Ideal for omnichannel businesses (online and physical stores) that need a single place to consolidate commercial, financial, and logistics information. Fewer errors, more efficiency.
SHOP-NS-001.cardSummary: Sync sales, logistics, and finance. Customers, orders, payments, and inventory always up to date.

AI-KM-001.title: KnowledgeHub AI - Smart knowledge base with conversational search
AI-KM-001.summary: Turn manuals, policies, SOPs, wikis, and contracts into an intelligent knowledge base. Our system indexes your files using vector embeddings and allows any employee to ask questions in natural language. Get accurate answers with the original source cited. Your company's knowledge, available without tedious searching.
AI-KM-001.cardSummary: Ask in natural language. Accurate answers citing manuals, policies, or contracts.

DEV-INT-001.title: Custom Integrations and Connectors
DEV-INT-001.summary: Have systems that don't communicate natively? We design custom bridges: ERP with e-commerce, CRM with marketing platforms, legacy systems with cloud applications, or third-party APIs with internal processes. We automate data flows where silos once existed. No patches, no chaos: clean and reliable integrations.
DEV-INT-001.cardSummary: ERP, CRM, legacy, or APIs. Smooth, automated data flows.

DEV-MOB-001.title: Mobile app development
DEV-MOB-001.summary: We create iOS and Android apps (native or cross-platform) focused on results: field apps for operational teams, self-service apps for customers, internal productivity tools, or mobile extensions of your enterprise systems. Functional design, real performance, and professional user experience.
DEV-MOB-001.cardSummary: For field, customers, or internal productivity. Native or cross-platform apps.

DEV-WEB-001.title: Web Application Development
DEV-WEB-001.summary: We build responsive, fast, and scalable web applications: corporate portals, SaaS platforms, operational dashboards, intranets, or self-service apps for customers or employees. We use modern frameworks and cloud deployment. Clean technology, minimalist design, and performance that drives your operation.
DEV-WEB-001.cardSummary: Portals, SaaS, dashboards, intranets. Modern, responsive, cloud-native.

DEV-CUSTOM-001.title: Custom software development
DEV-CUSTOM-001.summary: When off-the-shelf solutions don't meet your needs, we develop custom software that solves your exact problem. Includes requirements analysis, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support. An exact solution for a specific business.
DEV-CUSTOM-001.cardSummary: Solutions where no commercial product exists. From analysis to post-launch support.

AI-IPA-001.title: FlowMind AI - Intelligent business process automation
AI-IPA-001.summary: We combine configurable workflows with artificial intelligence to automate end-to-end business processes: document reading, rule-based and ML decision-making, action execution in systems, exception handling, and intelligent escalation. Your operation on autopilot.
AI-IPA-001.cardSummary: Reads documents, decides, executes, and escalates exceptions. No human intervention.

AI-VOICE-001.title: VoiceAgent AI - Smart voice agent for phone service
AI-VOICE-001.summary: Answer calls with natural voice, understand the caller's intent, access internal systems to provide real answers, and escalate to human agents only when necessary. Replace traditional IVRs, reduce call center costs, and dramatically improve customer experience.
AI-VOICE-001.cardSummary: Natural voice, real answers, human escalation only when needed.

AI-CHAT-001.title: AssistBot AI - Business transactional chatbot with systems integration
AI-CHAT-001.summary: It doesn't just answer questions — it takes real actions. Check orders in the ERP, schedule appointments, process requests, generate quotes, and create tickets, all from WhatsApp, web, or messaging channels. Connected to your internal systems. An assistant that truly works.
AI-CHAT-001.cardSummaryTitle: It doesn't just reply — it acts
AI-CHAT-001.cardSummary: Check orders, schedule appointments, or generate quotes from WhatsApp.

AI-PRED-001.title: ForecastAI - Demand prediction and forecasting with machine learning
AI-PRED-001.summary: Analyze sales history, seasonality, external events, and market signals to generate forecasts at the SKU, location, and period level. Integrates with your ERP to drive purchasing, production, and inventory planning. Less overstock, fewer stockouts.
AI-PRED-001.cardSummary: By SKU and location. Drives purchasing, production, and inventory.

AI-NL2SQL-001.title: DataTalk AI - Natural language database queries
AI-NL2SQL-001.summary: Allow business users to query databases, data warehouses, and enterprise systems in Spanish or English. They get instant answers with tables, charts, and explanatory narratives. No SQL required, no dependence on technical teams. Analytical autonomy for the entire team.
AI-NL2SQL-001.cardSummary: Get charts and tables. No SQL, no technical teams.

BM-001.title: Minimum Bases
BM-001.summary: Automate the decision to apply or not apply tax withholdings on purchase invoices, based on minimum amount thresholds established by Salvadoran tax law. Ensures that the 1% withholding on the VAT taxable base is calculated only when the amount exceeds $100 USD. Zero errors, guaranteed compliance.
BM-001.cardSummaryTitle: Comply with the law without manual calculations
BM-001.cardSummary: Applies 1% VAT only if exceeding $100. Automatic and precise.

MEL-001.title: Melonn - Fulfillment integration with NetSuite
MEL-001.summary: Fulfillment and logistics platform for e-commerce that manages the complete order fulfillment cycle. Its integration with NetSuite automatically synchronizes inventory transfers, adjustments, order execution, invoicing, and returns. Eliminates manual entry and ensures financial and operational traceability.
MEL-001.cardSummary: Orders, inventory, and returns synchronized with NetSuite.

NOV-NS-001.title: Novasoft integration - NetSuite ERP
NOV-NS-001.summary: Connect the Novasoft payroll and HR platform with NetSuite to automatically synchronize employees, accounting accounts, and journal entries. Eliminate double data entry and ensure financial and HR consistency.
NOV-NS-001.cardSummary: Employees, accounts, and entries without double entry.

YUJU-001.title: YUJU - Marketplace integration with NetSuite
YUJU-001.summary: Marketplace platform with bidirectional integration to NetSuite ERP that synchronizes product catalogs, sales orders, shipping executions, and invoicing. Companies selling through multiple channels manage their entire commercial cycle centralized in NetSuite. Manual operations out, control in.
YUJU-001.cardSummaryTitle: Sell through channels, operate in NetSuite
YUJU-001.cardSummary: Catalogs, orders, and invoicing in one place. No manual operation.

PR-001.title: Restrictive budget
PR-001.summary: Define, manage, and enforce spending limits by department or project. Automatically block purchase transactions that exceed budgeted amounts. Financial discipline and real-time visibility of budget execution without relying on spreadsheets.
PR-001.cardSummary: Blocks purchases that exceed budget. Real-time visibility.

TAX-001.title: TaxMX
TAX-001.summaryTitle: Automated Mexican Tax Compliance on NetSuite
TAX-001.summary: Automate three critical tax processes for Mexican companies: VAT reclassification upon cash collection/payment, DIOT generation in SAT-importable format, and controlled CFDI cancellation. Meet your tax obligations without manual intervention or errors.
TAX-001.cardSummaryTitle: VAT, DIOT, and CFDI without stress
TAX-001.cardSummary: Comply with SAT automatically from NetSuite.

PP-001.title: Supplier Portal
PP-001.summary: Allow your suppliers to access a secure web portal to upload digital tax receipts (CFDI) in XML and PDF, associate them with purchase orders, and automatically generate supplier invoices in NetSuite. Eliminate manual entry, centralize document receipt, and ensure Mexican tax compliance.
PP-001.cardSummary: Portal for suppliers: upload XML/PDF, the system generates the invoice in NetSuite.

H2H-001.title: H2H (Host to Host) - NetSuite integration with banks
H2H-001.summary: Connect NetSuite with Banco Santander's payment services to automate supplier payment disbursement and bank reconciliation. Eliminate manual mass payment operations, centralizing the generation, approval, and sending of payment files through encrypted secure communication.
H2H-001.cardSummary: Secure mass payments and effortless bank reconciliation.

POS-001.title: POS - Point of Sale Integration
POS-001.summaryTitle: POS (JONAS, Micros, Simphony, Aloha) with NetSuite
POS-001.summary: Connect Point of Sale systems (JONAS, Micros 9700, Simphony, Aloha) with NetSuite to automatically record sales, electronic CFDI/SAT invoicing, and the correct accounting impact on revenue accounts. Eliminate manual entry and centralize operational information from your physical stores.
POS-001.cardSummary: Physical sales with CFDI/SAT invoicing. Automatic accounting impact.

VXML-001.title: XML Validator
VXML-001.summary: Automate the receipt, validation, and assignment of digital tax receipts (XML) to purchase and expense transactions in NetSuite. Ensure Mexican tax compliance by guaranteeing that each invoice has its properly validated and linked XML. No risks, no invalid invoices.
VXML-001.cardSummaryTitle: Every invoice with its valid XML
VXML-001.cardSummary: Automatic receipt, validation, and linking of CFDI in NetSuite.

AI-DOC-001.title: DocuMind AI - Intelligent platform for automated document extraction and registration
AI-DOC-001.summary: Read invoices, purchase orders, XML files, and other documents, automatically extract relevant information, validate it against enterprise catalogs, and generate transactions ready to be recorded in the ERP. Intelligent capture, zero typing errors, faster and more reliable accounts payable processes.
AI-DOC-001.cardSummary: Extract, validate, and generate ERP entries. No typing errors.
